name: Beta Boulders
description: Beta Boulders combines a climbing gym, fitness space, co-working area and café inside the northern former Citroën garage beside the Olympic Stadium. Jan Wils designed this maintenance garage separately from the older southern showroom. Its later transformation into The Garage restored the glass curtain wall and connected offices, restaurants and other shared uses along the original car ramp. Beta occupies part of this multi-tenant building.
